job.job_description:
Role Summary




We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud & AI Fullstack Developer to design, build, and deploy

scalable applications leveraging AWS services, serverless/microservice architectures, and

modern fullstack frameworks. The role involves hands on development across cloud

infrastructure, AI/GenAI solutions, and frontend/backend stacks, ensuring secure,

performant, and innovative delivery.




Key Responsibilities

• Architect and implement applications using AWS services (Connect, S3, SQS, SNS, API

Gateway, EC2, Lambda, AppSync, Kinesis, Lex, Polly, Transcribe, ECS, EKS, ECR).

• Design and deliver serverless and microservice architectures using Docker, Lambda,

ECS, and EKS.

• Configure and manage networking components (VPC, Ingress/Egress, Security

Groups, Load Balancers).

• Develop fullstack applications using Node.js, ReactJS, NextJS, TypeScript, MERN

stack.

• Build and integrate GenAI applications (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering,

hallucination handling, completions, temperature tuning).

• Work with LangChain, LangGraph, Python for AI/ML pipelines.

• Implement speech technologies (Text to Speech, Speech to Text, Speech to Speech).

• Integrate with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB).

• Develop CI/CD pipelines (BitBucket, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).

• Write unit and integration tests using Jest, Playwright, Cypress.

• Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform.

• Collaborate with Contact Center solutions and WebRTC integrations where

applicable.




Mandatory Skills (Critical for Role Success)

• AWS Cloud Expertise: Strong know how of AWS technology stack and services.

• Serverless & Microservice Architecture: Hands on with Docker, Lambda, ECS, EKS.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency with Terraform.

• Fullstack Development: In depth experience with Node.js, ReactJS, NextJS,

TypeScript, MERN stack.

• GenAI Development: Experience building GenAI applications with LangChain,

LangGraph, Python and concepts like RAG, hallucination, completions, tokens,

temperature.




Preferred / Nice to Have

• AWS Solutions Architect or equivalent certification.

• Experience with WebRTC and Contact Center solutions.

• Exposure to Google ADK.

• Knowledge of speech technologies (Lex, Polly, Transcribe).

• Experience with CI/CD tooling (BitBucket pipeline).

• Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB).

• Unit testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress).
